_newKeys_shapeMods.note: modifiers on every shape (js/art.js modArtKeys()): mod_<mod>_<shape> 42x42 overlays (die at 2,8; ring traced to that shape + badge), mod_badge_<mod> 28x11 (die origin + (11,-8), any shape), Overcharged +3 faces die_<shape>_face<n>. Every key has an hc twin.

_newKeys_buttons.note: ui_btn_continue / ui_btn_endless: labelled skins. ui_btn_<name>_blank: label-free skin for every button (same size, game draws its text inside textArea, native px; x2 for CSS). All have kind:"button" + states + hc twins.

_newKeys_counters.note: binary counters are one die slot (32x32 native = 64x64 CSS at 1x). counter_* keys are the pack names; game_keys_mapped are the existing counterArtKeys() names pointed at the same files. See README > Binary counters.

_doc: Drop-in for assets/manifest.json (copy the pack folder to assets/pack-styleA/). Keys the game already uses map to style-A art; every other pack sprite is listed under its own name. 1x src = native x2 = CSS size; set pixelated: true.
